name: Eric M Demarco
current_role: President, CEO and Director, Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (NASDAQ: KTOS)

name: Steven Leonard Chapman
current_role: CEO, President and Director, Natera, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTRA), since January 2019

profile: André Schwämmlein co-founded FlixBus in Munich in 2011 with Daniel Krauss and Jochen Engert, launching its first routes in Bavaria in 2013 as Germany deregulated intercity buses.
